Aged Receivables — Edit

The Aged Receivables report analyzes outstanding customer invoices by how long they've been unpaid.

Customer balances are grouped into aging periods like current, 30 days, 60 days, and 90+ days overdue.

Use this report to prioritize collection efforts, identify problem accounts, and assess credit risk.

The aging analysis helps you estimate potential bad debts and make informed credit decisions.

Configure the report date, aging periods, and whether to include zero-balance customers.

Date

Select the date for aging calculations. Today uses the current date, while Custom lets you specify a specific date.

CustomDate

Enter the specific date to calculate aging from when using Custom date type.

Division

Select a division to filter the report to show only receivables for that division.

Sort By

Select how to sort the report: by customer name or by total amount owed.

Description

Enter an optional description for this report configuration.

Show Invoices

Check this box to show individual invoice details for each customer.
